thought: This is a landscape/setting-focused prompt for Langya Mountain, the primary location of the historical story. The distinctive feature is the jagged, interlocking tooth-like peaks. The emphasis is on the harsh, strategic terrain with its mix of dense forest and exposed rocky ridges, captured in the desaturated earth-tone palette characteristic of the visual style. The mood must convey the solemnity and epic nature of the 1941 historical event.
prompt: Wide establishing landscape shot of Langya Mountain range, showcasing the distinctive jagged peaks interlocking like wolf's fangs against an overcast autumn sky. Eye-level to slightly low-angle view emphasizing the imposing, strategic terrain. Layered composition with multiple mountain ridges receding into atmospheric perspective, foreground featuring steep rocky cliffs with exposed granite surfaces, waist-high yellowed mountain grass, and thorny scrub vegetation, middle ground showing dense coniferous and deciduous forest groves interspersed with bare rocky outcroppings and treacherous ravines, background revealing the serpentine Yi River flowing at the mountain's base through the valley. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with diffused overcast autumn light creating strong contrast between shadowed cliff faces and illuminated rocky ridges. Extremely rugged topography with visible steep slopes, sharp drop-offs, and险峻 precipices. Desaturated earth-tone color palette dominated by muted ochres, dusty grays, faded olive greens, and weathered browns, emphasizing 1941 autumn season. Solemn, harsh, and epic atmosphere conveying historical gravitas and the mountain's role as a formidable natural barrier. Realistic heavily-painted 2D animation style with visible thick brush strokes, strong painterly texture, and pronounced light-dark contrast characteristic of historical war illustrations. Deep depth of field maintaining sharpness across all mountain layers from foreground boulders to distant peaks. Environmental landscape portraiture in the style of documentary historical illustration. Cinematic, moody, low-key lighting with cool-to-neutral color temperature. Strategic emphasis on the treacherous, defensible nature of the mountainous terrain.
